svg.title: fn-data
svg.desc: A rising line with an arrowhead: fiscal notes, what a bill would cost. It stands on the detached base bar that marks the public-record stores. Drawn in one ink on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules, for the page to paint in its text colour: solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
